description: Closed named-exemption registry for zh/sync/service-http-binding.md 2.2.2. That section requires every gate-scoped required request input (evidence-shaped or CAS/echo-shaped leaves, and untyped required objects) to have a registered supply source, and every declared FSM state and allowed transition to have a registered write. Rows carry individually adjudicated exceptions in two kinds: request_input rows per operation and json-path prefix, fsm_transition rows per cell family with the waived states and transitions. Structural rules live in the machine gate, not here: this registry only carries individually adjudicated exceptions so that a blanket category can never be smuggled in as a row.

disposition_semantics.external_form: The field intentionally carries an external standard's own wire form (for example a did:webvh operation object). rationale MUST name the external standard and where its shape is defined. The row is permanent until the carrier design changes.
disposition_semantics.open_finding: A confirmed supply or reachability gap that is not fixed yet. review_anchor MUST point at a review/spec-open entry in arkret-work that still exists; when the finding closes the row MUST be deleted in the same change, otherwise the reverse check fails.
disposition_semantics.deferred_supply: The supply surface is adjudicated but its implementation is scheduled for a later wave. review_anchor MUST point at the adjudication record.

registry_rules.review_anchor_shape: Relative path from the arkret workspace root plus a heading substring that MUST appear verbatim in that file. Only consulted for open_finding and deferred_supply rows; the gate skips the file check when the workspace root is absent (spec repo checked out alone).

exemptions.rationale: Carries a did:webvh log operation in the DID method's own form, per the b8cfa51a ruling that DID logs cross the wire in method-native shape instead of an arkret envelope. The shape is defined by the did:webvh specification and validated by the method implementation, not by an arkret schema.
Same method-native did:webvh operation carrier as ak.root.identity.command.submit_did_operation, embedded in the identity binding challenge flow.
